units.title: My Things

continuous_text.title: This Is My Bag
continuous_text.content:
This is my bag.
It's red and blue.
I have a pen,
And a ruler, too.

This is my pencil.
This is my book.
This is my eraser.
Look! Look!
continuous_text.notes: Audio tracks 039 and 040. Includes alternative substitution word: your.

continuous_text.title: Nisha's Jump Rope
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1
Narrator: This is Nisha. This is her favorite toy.
Nisha: I have a jump rope.

Frame 2
Adnan: Look! It's my boat.
Nisha: Don't worry, Adnan!

Frame 3
Adnan: Thank you!
Nisha: Now I don't have a jump rope. Oh, no!

Frame 4
Nisha: I have a ball. Here!
Adnan: Thanks.

Frame 5
Zara: Look! It's my kite.
Nisha: Don't worry, Zara!

Frame 6
Zara: Thank you!
Nisha: Now I don't have a ball. Oh, no!

Frame 7
Narrator: Here's Zara's mom. What's in her bag?
Zara's Mom: I have a jump rope.
Nisha: Oh! Thank you!

Frame 8
Narrator: Hurray!
Nisha: It's my favorite toy!
continuous_text.speaker_structure: Narrator, Nisha, Adnan, Zara, Zara's Mom
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 4 Story across pages 24 and 25. Teaches generosity and sharing.

continuous_text.title: A Pen Pal Letter
continuous_text.content:
Dear Carlos,
I'm Cedric. I'm from Madagascar.
What toys do you have? I have a boat. It's red and brown.
I have a ball, too. It's green.
I don't have a skateboard, and I don't have a scooter.
My favorite toy is my board game. What's your favorite toy?
From,
Cedric
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 5 Reading passage formatted as an informal letter.

schema_gaps.observed_content: 'Think, Feel, Grow' section on page 25 ('Can you help your friends? What can you do? Share your ideas.') explicitly mapped in syllabus (p. 3) to 'Emotional Well-being: Being generous'.
schema_gaps.problem: The current schema lacks a dedicated structure for social-emotional learning (SEL) competencies and reflective questions.
schema_gaps.proposed_change: Add an optional 'social_emotional_learning' entity containing 'competency_label' and 'reflective_prompt'.
